Subject: Q3 pipeline taxonomy update + calibration office hours

Hi all,

Quick note to share a small but important change we're rolling into Q3: we've tightened the definitions for Commit / Best Case / Pipeline so forecasting math aligns across Sales, RevOps, and Finance. The goal is clearer handoffs and fewer surprise deals in the week-before-close.

What changed (short):
- Commit: deals with signed verbal commitment + legal/finance procurement engagement and predictable PO timing (move out of Commit only if explicit cancelation).
- Best Case: strong customer intent, senior economic buyer involvement, POC scheduled, but outstanding contract terms or procurement gating remains.
- Pipeline: early discovery / evaluation stage without firm timebound close expectations.

I've attached the Q3 taxonomy spreadsheet and a 1‑page summary. Please review before our office hours next week — we're running 30-minute calibration sessions for each AE pod to walk real deals through the rubric.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-07-14 10:00–10:30
- Tue 2026-07-14 14:00–14:30
- Wed 2026-07-15 09:00–09:30

Susan / BlueWave — if you'd like to join the pod session for your account (DW-7834) we can slot you into the 14:00 session; otherwise we will apply the taxonomy to your pipeline in our weekly forecast review.
